tested_changes: Uncommitted read-only ClamAV definition status and pre-scan freshness/update advice

behavior.inspection: Only the owner-configured clamscan --version; parses the existing local-time daily database stamp
behavior.freshness: Exact age is compared to the configured maximum; exactly at the limit is fresh, one microsecond over is stale. Missing or future dates are unknown
behavior.scope: A daily stamp does not verify the integrity or completeness of every database, update-service health, or PC safety
behavior.failure: Missing/unstartable engine, invalid version response, timeout or cancellation returns check_failed with error and update guidance
behavior.pre_scan: Normal, batch and resume malware scans inspect definitions before directory traversal; CLI stderr and MCP notifications carry summary and owner-managed update advice immediately
behavior.pre_scan_result: Retained as data.signature_check including after ordinary ScannerError failures; existing per-target and batch-completion freshness checks are preserved
behavior.continuation: Stale/unknown retains warnings and at least partial status; failed inspection prevents scanning
behavior.deadlines: Standalone check uses min(configured timeout, 30 seconds). Pre-scan probe shares the scan deadline; immediate MCP advice delivery waits at most one second
behavior.updates: No updater is executed. Advice points to the owner's configured official freshclam service or approved configuration and permissions, then rechecking. Permission failures require administrator action without automatic ownership/permission changes
behavior.batch_reuse: Advice explains that real ClamAV stderr warnings about old definitions can prevent reuse
behavior.read_only: Standalone checks perform no scan, network/release lookup, history or checkpoint write, database update or permission change

coverage: Standalone fresh status without scan roots or history writes
Stale advice is available before walking and retained in the final result
Exact expiry and one microsecond over
Missing and future dates stay unknown
Failed inspection is distinct and prevents walking
Only --version is executed, with bounded timeout and no release lookup
Pre-cancelled check never starts the engine
Post-advice scan errors retain the signature evidence
Unauthorized aliases are rejected before the engine starts
Real CLI command emits one JSON result and reports failed invalid-engine response
MCP tool works without roots and declares local read-only behavior
MCP pre-scan advice is delivered before directory traversal
An actual child process is stopped at the standalone check deadline
Probe and scan share one deadline with an actual timed-out engine child
Control characters in engine version are escaped before progress display
regression_tests.existing_fixture_changes: CLI and cloud-only MCP fixtures now supply a valid version response because pre-scan inspection occurs before traversal; tool-list expectations include the new tool

actual_mac_read_only_probe.transport: Real SDK client to CLI serve subprocess over stdio

remaining: Explicit MCP definition updating is not implemented; database destination and privilege policy still require a decision
Normal installed definitions are still old; this feature only reports and advises
Native Windows acceptance and Windows CI were not run here
Third-party MCP graphical client rendering was not manually checked
